title: Incident Bot v2 — Signal Inventory (deploy/config/saturation) [working sheet]
content:
Sheet: Signal inventory for Incident Bot v2
Last reviewed: 2025-04-08 (weekly sync w/ SRE + Telemetry + Platform)

Purpose
- Single place to track: (a) desired incident signals, (b) current source-of-truth, (c) query shape + estimated cost, (d) gaps/owners.
- Used to scope bot cards + guardrails (timeouts, caching, rate limits) and to define “context completeness” score.

Legend
- Priority: P0 must-have for GA / P1 should-have / P2 nice-to-have
- Query cost (rough): Low / Med / High (combines expected p95 query latency + cardinality risk + backend load)
- Tenant safety: Safe-by-default means bot can fetch without elevated scopes; Privileged means needs restricted scope + audit event; Break-glass means Sev0/Sev1 only.

Constraints / guardrails (must hold for all signals)
- Max bot synchronous budget: 2.5s total for initial cards (target 1.2s), per-source timeout 700ms, 1 retry max with jitter.
- Bounded cardinality: prefer pre-aggregated metrics; avoid high-cardinality tags (tenant_id, request_id) unless behind explicit drill-down.
- Tenant-safe rendering: all config diffs must be redacted + allowlisted; no secrets, no raw prompts, no customer identifiers in Slack.
- Degraded mode: if queries fail/timeout, return cached summary + deep links (Console / dashboards / traces).

Columns
Category | Signal | What it answers | Priority | Target card | Source of truth | Endpoint / query shape | Tenancy / permissions | Freshness | Query cost | Est. p95 | Notes / gaps | Owner | Status

INVENTORY (working)
Deploy | Recent deploys (per service/region) | “Did anything change recently?” | P0 | Recent deploys | Release metadata svc (deploy-events) | GET /internal/deploys?service={s}&region={r}&since=60m | Safe-by-default (service-level) | 1–2 min | Low | 80–150ms | Needs canonical service registry join (see releases thread) | Connor O'Brien | In progress
Deploy | Deployed version (image SHA) | “What code is running?” | P0 | Recent deploys | Deploy metadata export | Included in deploys response: image_sha, build_id | Safe-by-default | 1–2 min | Low | 80–150ms | Ensure SHA link resolves to GitHub compare | Connor O'Brien | In progress
Deploy | Rollout phase | “Canary vs full rollout?” | P0 | Recent deploys | Rollout controller | deploy.rollout_phase (canary/gradual/full) | Safe-by-default | 1–2 min | Low | 100–180ms | Need consistent enum across services | Sahana Iyer | In progress
Deploy | Canary health summary | “Is canary failing?” | P0 | Recent deploys | Perf canary + rollout health | GET /internal/rollouts/health?rollout_id={id} | Safe-by-default | 1–5 min | Med | 200–450ms | Must not query per-pod; use rollout-level aggregate | Aisha Bello | In progress
Deploy | Related PR(s) / change list | “What changed in that deploy?” | P1 | Recent deploys | GitHub mapping service | deploy -> commit -> PR links | Safe-by-default | 5–10 min | Med | 250–600ms | Mapping gaps for hotfixes / cherry-picks | Sahana Iyer | Not started
Deploy | Deploy timeline deep link | “Where is this on the deploy timeline?” | P0 | Recent deploys | Console | Precomputed URL template | Safe-by-default | n/a | Low | n/a | Needs exact URL params (service, region, time window) | Chloe Martin | In progress
Deploy | Rollback events (last 6h) | “Did we recently roll back?” | P1 | Recent deploys | Deploy events stream | GET /internal/deploys?event=rollback&since=6h | Safe-by-default | 1–2 min | Low | 120–220ms | Add ‘reason’ field if available | Connor O'Brien | Not started

Config | Tenant-safe config diff (service-level) | “Did config change cause this?” | P0 | Config changes | Config service | POST /internal/config/diff (old_rev,new_rev, scope=service) | Privileged + audit (bot scope: config.diff:read) | 1–3 min | Med | 250–700ms | Must render allowlisted fields only | Benji Okafor | In progress
Config | Tenant-safe config diff (tenant/route scoped) | “Was this tenant impacted by a pin/quota?” | P0 | Config changes | Config service | POST /internal/config/diff?tenant={t}&route={rt} | Break-glass + audit + oncall role | 1–3 min | High | 500–1200ms | Default OFF; require click-through action w/ reason | Kaitlyn Nguyen | In review
Config | Feature flags changed (last 2h) | “Did a flag rollout flip?” | P0 | Config changes | Flag service | GET /flags/changes?service={s}&since=2h | Privileged + audit | 1–2 min | Med | 200–500ms | Need redaction for targeting rules | Benji Okafor | In progress
Config | Routing policy diff (fallbacks, regions) | “Did routing change cause 503s?” | P0 | Config changes | Routing policy engine | GET /routing/policy/diff?service={s}&since=2h | Privileged + audit | 1–2 min | Med | 250–650ms | Requires stable diff format (JSON patch) | Mina Haddad | In progress
Config | Model pin changes | “Did model version change?” | P0 | Config changes | Model registry + policy | policy.model_pin (old->new) | Privileged + audit | 1–2 min | Med | 250–650ms | Must show ‘compatibility / fallback’ info | Jordan Lee | Not started
Config | Quota / rate-limit changes | “Did limits change?” | P1 | Config changes | Quota service | GET /quota/changes?service={s}&since=6h | Privileged + audit | 5 min | Med | 250–700ms | Potential to confuse w/ runtime throttling; needs labels | Priya Natarajan | Not started
Config | Autoscaling policy changes (Dedicated pools) | “Did someone reduce capacity?” | P1 | Config changes | Capacity manager | GET /capacity/policy/changes?pool={p}&since=6h | Privileged + audit | 5 min | Med | 250–700ms | Must be pool-safe; no customer names in Slack | Ethan Park | Not started
Config | Redaction coverage score | “Are we leaking sensitive fields?” | P0 | Config changes | Bot renderer tests + runtime | % fields redacted vs allowlisted | Safe-by-default | per deploy | Low | n/a | Track in CI and bot logs | Marcus Lin | In progress

Saturation | GPU utilization (per pool/region) | “Are GPUs maxed?” | P0 | Saturation overview | Metrics (gpu_utilization) | avg_over_5m(gpu.util{pool,region}) | Safe-by-default (aggregate only) | 1 min | Low | 120–250ms | Highlight >85% for 10m, warn >95% for 5m | Nadia Rahman | In progress
Saturation | GPU memory utilization | “OOM risk / model too large?” | P1 | Saturation overview | Metrics (gpu_mem_used) | p95_over_5m(gpu.mem_util{pool,region}) | Safe-by-default (aggregate) | 1 min | Low | 120–250ms | Needs consistent exporter across clusters | Nadia Rahman | Not started
Saturation | KV cache pressure | “Are long contexts blowing cache?” | P0 | Saturation overview | Runtime metrics | kv_cache.evictions_rate, kv_cache.usage_ratio | Safe-by-default (aggregate) | 1 min | Med | 200–450ms | Need clear action text (reduce max_tokens, enable truncation) | Logan Wright | In progress
Saturation | Queue depth (scheduler) | “Are requests piling up?” | P0 | Saturation overview | Scheduler metrics | max_over_2m(scheduler.queue_depth{region,pool}) | Safe-by-default | 30s–1m | Low | 120–250ms | Prefer pool-level; avoid per-route unless drill-down | Caleb Johnson | In progress
Saturation | Admission control / backpressure | “Are we rejecting or shedding?” | P0 | Saturation overview | Scheduler metrics | rate(admission.rejects{reason,region}) | Safe-by-default (aggregate by reason) | 1 min | Med | 180–350ms | Ensure reason list is bounded enum | Ravi Menon | In progress
Saturation | Request concurrency / in-flight | “Are we hitting concurrency caps?” | P1 | Saturation overview | Gateway metrics | avg(inflight_requests{service,region}) | Safe-by-default | 1 min | Low | 120–250ms | Useful for streaming incidents | Allison Grant | Not started
Saturation | p95 time-in-queue | “Is latency queueing vs compute?” | P0 | Saturation overview | Tracing-derived metric | p95(queue_wait_ms{service,region}) | Safe-by-default (aggregate) | 2–5 min | Med | 250–600ms | Requires trace sampling stability during incidents | Caleb Johnson | In review
Saturation | Batch size / batching effectiveness | “Is batching working?” | P1 | Saturation overview | Runtime metrics | avg(batch.size), avg(batch.wait_ms) | Safe-by-default | 1 min | Med | 200–500ms | Add simple heuristic: ‘batching off or constrained’ | Logan Wright | Not started
Saturation | Prefix cache hit rate | “Are we benefiting from cache?” | P2 | Saturation overview | Runtime metrics | avg(prefix_cache.hit_rate{service,region}) | Safe-by-default | 1 min | Med | 200–450ms | Only relevant for certain endpoints; conditional card | Jacob Stein | Not started
Saturation | Regional capacity headroom | “Do we have spare capacity?” | P0 | Saturation overview | Capacity service | GET /capacity/headroom?pool={p}&region={r} | Privileged + audit (internal) | 1–2 min | Med | 250–800ms | Must degrade to cached when capacity svc unhealthy | Ethan Park | In progress
Saturation | Fallback routing active (rate) | “Are we failing over?” | P0 | Saturation overview | Routing metrics | rate(fallback_routed{from,to,region}) (bounded tags) | Safe-by-default (aggregate) | 1 min | Med | 200–500ms | Past incident: tag cardinality; enforce allowlist (from,to only) | Mina Haddad | In progress

Errors / SLO context | 5xx rate (per service/region) | “Is it an availability issue?” | P0 | SLO / burn | Metrics | rate(http_5xx{service,region}) | Safe-by-default | 1 min | Low | 100–250ms | Used to decide degraded mode | Allison Grant | In progress
Errors / SLO context | p95 latency (per route) | “Which route is slow?” | P0 | SLO / burn | Metrics | p95(latency_ms{route,region}) (route allowlist) | Safe-by-default | 1 min | Med | 200–600ms | Route tag must be allowlisted; top-N only | Allison Grant | In progress
Errors / SLO context | Streaming disconnect rate | “Are streams dropping?” | P0 | SLO / burn | Gateway metrics | rate(stream.disconnects{region,reason}) | Safe-by-default | 1 min | Med | 200–500ms | Map reason codes to runbook steps | Aisha Bello | In progress
Errors / SLO context | Error budget burn link | “Where is SLO burning?” | P0 | SLO / burn | SLO toolkit | Generate URL (service/route/region/time) | Safe-by-default | n/a | Low | n/a | Must match Console SLO page params | Aisha Bello | In progress
Errors / SLO context | Top error reasons (bounded) | “What is failing?” | P1 | SLO / burn | Logs->metric summary | topk(5, rate(error_reason{enum})) | Safe-by-default (bounded enum) | 2–5 min | High | 600–1500ms | Likely too slow for initial card; put behind action | Miles Thornton | Not started

Tracing / drill-down links | Trace search deep link | “Give me traces in the incident window” | P0 | Links | Console tracing | URL template w/ service+region+time | Safe-by-default | n/a | Low | n/a | Keep time window narrow (last 30m default) | Chloe Martin | In progress
Tracing / drill-down links | Log correlation deep link | “Jump to logs for this service/region” | P0 | Links | Observability pack | URL template | Safe-by-default | n/a | Low | n/a | Must not include tenant_id by default | Chloe Martin | In progress

Bot health / guardrails | Telemetry query latency (bot) | “Is the bot itself slow?” | P0 | Bot footer | Bot metrics | p95(bot.telemetry_query_ms) | Safe-by-default | 1 min | Low | 80–150ms | Also feeds perf canary + alert | Miles Thornton | In progress
Bot health / guardrails | Cache hit rate (bot) | “Are we hammering telemetry?” | P0 | Bot footer | Bot metrics | avg(bot.cache_hit_rate{source}) | Safe-by-default | 1 min | Low | 80–150ms | Target >60% during incidents | Miles Thornton | In progress
Bot health / guardrails | Query budget exceeded counter | “Are we load shedding?” | P0 | Bot footer | Bot metrics | rate(bot.budget_exceeded{source}) | Safe-by-default | 1 min | Low | 80–150ms | Should be 0 outside Sev0/Sev1 | Rafael Mendes | In progress

Open questions (as of 2025-04-08)
- Do we standardize ‘pool’ naming across Hosted/Dedicated/Private for dashboards + bot cards? (affects capacity/headroom, gpu_util, queue depth)
- For config diffs: default to service-level diff always, and only allow tenant/route diff via interactive action w/ reason + audit event?
- What is the minimum set of saturation signals that are actually actionable in the first 5 minutes (to avoid card noise)?

Next steps
- Jacob: propose GA “context completeness” scoring rubric (deploy+config+saturation present; also degraded mode success).
- Logan + Nadia: finalize KV cache + scheduler metrics names and aggregation windows.
- Connor + Sahana: close deploy<->service registry gaps; ensure PR links are correct for hotfixes.
- Benji + Kaitlyn + Marcus: finalize redaction allowlist + tests; document break-glass flow + audit event schema.

Notes to self (Jacob)
- Keep initial card summary <= ~10 lines; everything else should be click-through (modal/pagination).
- If we can’t make a signal cheap, it can’t be part of the default payload. Put it behind an action or a deep link.
